title: Although or Even If
goal: Use aunque + the indicative for a fact and aunque + the subjunctive for a possibility or a point you grant, and recall sin embargo and no obstante.

sections.title: Unit 8: Concession and Counter-Argument
body: At B2 you often have to admit a difficulty and still keep your position. This unit is about the connectors that do this, and about the choice between the indicative (the obstacle is a fact) and the subjunctive (the obstacle is only possible, or you grant it for the sake of argument).

You will practise aunque, si bien, por más que and aun cuando, and the repeated subjunctive of pase lo que pase. The unit ends with a short text about the Cuban writer Alejo Carpentier and his novel El reino de este mundo.

items: I can use aunque with the indicative for a fact and with the subjunctive for a possibility or a point I grant.
I can join two sentences with sin embargo or no obstante instead of aunque.
I can use the new words for facts and objections.
